{"[2020DO10729]": "We examine the 항소이유를.

1. a. When 수사기관 execute a 압수ㆍ수색영장, the 피압수자 or 변호인 may 참여 in its 집행(Articles 219 and 121 of the Criminal Procedure Act). Even where, in the course of a 압수ㆍ수색 of 저장매체, it is impossible to print and duplicate within the fixed 범위, or where 예외적인 사정 are recognized in which it is markedly difficult to accomplish the purpose of 압수, and the 저장매체 containing 전자정보, 하드카피, or 이미징 and other forms(hereinafter referred to as the “복제본”) are moved to the 수사기관 사무실, etc. for 복제, 탐색, and 출력, the 원칙 of 영장주의 and 적법절차 must still be observed by guaranteeing the opportunity for the 피압수자 or the 변호인 to participate and by taking 적절한 조치 to prevent 임의적인 복제, etc. of 전자정보 unrelated to the 혐의사실. If such measures were not taken, then, unless there are 특별한 사정 such as where the side of the 피압수자 explicitly indicated an 의사 not to participate in the above 절차 or 과정, or where it cannot be said that the purpose of 보장 of 참여 in the 절차 was substantially infringed in light of the nature and 내용 of the 과정 in which the 절차위반 occurred, the 압수 and 수색 cannot be said to be 적법. The same applies even where the 수사기관 duplicated and printed only the 전자정보 related to the 혐의사실 from the 저장매체 or the 복제본(see Supreme Court en banc Decision dated 2015. 7. 16. in 2011MO1839, Supreme Court Judgment dated 2017. 9. 21. in 2015DO12400, etc.).

Meanwhile, the 변호인’s 참여권, as provided in Articles 219 and 121 of the Criminal Procedure Act, is an 고유권 granted to the 변호인 for the 보호 of the 피압수자. Therefore, even if the 피압수자 explicitly indicated to the 수사기관 an 의사 not to participate in the 집행 of the 압수ㆍ수색영장, the 변호인 must, unless 특별한 사정 exist, be separately guaranteed an opportunity to participate in the 집행 of the 압수ㆍ수색영장 by being notified in advance of the time and place of 집행 pursuant to Articles 219 and 122 of the Criminal Procedure Act.

b. Article 308-2 of the Criminal Procedure Act provides that “evidence collected in violation of 적법한 절차 shall not be admissible as 증거.” This explicitly sets forth the 위법수집증거 배제법칙 in order to realize the constitutional ideal of guaranteeing the 국민의 기본적 인권 by suppressing unlawful acts in 수사과정, including unlawful 압수 and 수색, and preventing their recurrence(see Supreme Court Judgment dated 2013. 3. 14. in 2010DO2094, Supreme Court Judgment dated 2019. 7. 11. in 2018DO20504, etc.). Article 12 of the Constitution declares the principles of 적법절차 and 영장주의 with respect to 압수 and 수색 in order to guarantee 기본적 인권, and the Criminal Procedure Act inherits this and establishes 구체적 기준 concerning 압수ㆍ수색절차 so as to harmoniously realize the ideals of 실체적 진실 발견 and 개인의 권리보호. Since it is necessary to firmly maintain the 규범력 of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act and to suppress unlawful acts in 수사과정, evidence collected not only in violation of 적법한 절차 but also 2차적 증거 obtained on the basis thereof should be regarded as having been secured without lawful procedures prepared for the protection of fundamental rights and, in principle, cannot be used as evidence for conviction.

However, uniformly denying 증거능력 merely because evidence was collected without following the procedures prescribed by law does not accord with the purposes of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act. This is because the realization of legitimate 형벌권 through the discovery of 실체적 진실 is also an important 목표 and 이념 that the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act seek to achieve through 형사소송절차. If the 수사기관’s 절차위반 does not amount to an infringement of the substantive content of 적법절차, and rather it is an 예외적인 case in which excluding 증거능력 would be evaluated as producing a result contrary to the intent of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act in establishing 절차 provisions for 형사소송 so as to seek harmony between the 원칙 of 적법절차 and the discovery of 실체적 진실 and thereby realize 형사사법 정의, the court should find that such evidence may be used as evidence for conviction. Whether this applies must be determined by comprehensively and holistically examining all circumstances relating to the 절차위반 committed in the course of the 수사기관’s collection of 증거, namely, the purport of the 절차조항, the content and degree of the violation, the specific circumstances and 회피가능성 of the violation, the nature of the 권리 or 법익 that the 절차조항 seeks to protect and the degree of infringement, the relationship between such 권리 or 법익 and the 피고인, the relationship between the 절차위반 and the collection of 증거, and the 수사기관’s 인식 and 의도. Since this 법리 applies equally to 2차적 증거 obtained on the basis of evidence collected without lawful procedures, secondary evidence may also be used as evidence for conviction in exceptional cases by comprehensively and holistically considering all circumstances relating to the collection of secondary evidence, focusing on whether the 인과관계 between the collection of evidence without procedure and the collection of secondary evidence has been attenuated or severed(see Supreme Court en banc Decision dated 2007. 11. 15. in 2007DO3061, Supreme Court en banc Decision dated 2015. 1. 22. in 2014DO10978, Supreme Court Judgment dated 2019. 7. 11. in 2018DO20504, etc.).

2. a. The gist of the charged facts at issue in this case is as follows.

The Defendant, at an unknown time in or before 2019, in the restroom of “○○ Singing Practice Room” located in Uijeongbu-si(address omitted), attached, by using tape, a small camera wrapped in vinyl to the outside of a trash can inside the toilet stall there, attached a portable battery connected to the above camera to the inside of the trash can, and then pressed the record button, thereby filming the buttocks and genitals of an unidentified female who was using the toilet in that restroom; in addition, from around 2013 to around 2019, the Defendant filmed the victims using the toilet in restrooms on a total of 296 occasions as set forth in numbers 1 through 296 of the crime list table cited in the judgment below. In this way, the Defendant, by using a camera or any other mechanical device with a similar function, filmed the body of another person that may arouse sexual desire or cause shame, against that person’s will.

b. The lower court, for the following reasons, found that this portion of the charged facts fell under a case in which the facts constituting the offense were not proven, and thus reversed the first-instance judgment that had found the Defendant guilty and held him not guilty.

1) The 수사기관 violated 적법절차 by executing the 압수ㆍ수색영장 on 2019. 10. 30. in the 수사기관’s office by searching, duplicating, and printing the 저장매체, without having previously notified the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel of the time and place of 집행.

2) Considering that the Defendant was then in 구속 and the importance of the 참여절차 prescribed in Articles 219 and 121 of the Criminal Procedure Act, the above violation of 적법절차 was serious in degree.

3) Therefore, video capture printouts, etc. collected through the unlawful 압수 and 수색 cannot be used as evidence pursuant to Article 308-2 of the Criminal Procedure Act, and the Defendant’s confession is also a product based on those pieces of evidence or the only evidence for this portion of the charged facts, so it cannot be used as evidence of guilt pursuant to Article 308-2 or Article 310 of the Criminal Procedure Act.

3. The lower court’s above determination cannot be accepted as is for the following reasons.

a. According to the reasoning of the lower court judgment and the record, the following facts may be found.

1) A judicial police officer affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, Police Lieutenant Nonparty 1, on 2019. 10. 25. at around 09:00, removed from the Defendant’s residence to the police station, by way of taking them out, one computer main unit owned by the Defendant(hereinafter referred to as the “computer at issue”) and one Galaxy Note8 mobile phone(hereinafter referred to as the “mobile phone at issue”), on the basis of the search, seizure, and inspection warrant dated 2019. 10. 24. issued by a judge of the Uijeongbu District Court(hereinafter referred to as the “warrant at issue”).

2) At that time, the Defendant handwrote a “V” mark and signed and affixed his thumbprint on the portions of the confirmation forms for removal of the original for the computer at issue and the mobile phone at issue stating, “I participated in the process of sealing the digital device and storage media and confirmed that there was no problem with the sealing; I was notified that I may participate in the process of unsealing, obtaining the duplicate copy, and searching, duplicating, and printing the digital device, storage media, or duplicate copy; and I will not participate in the above process.”

3) In the first police interrogation of the suspect immediately thereafter, the Defendant stated, “Since 4 to 5 years ago, I installed a hidden camera purchased online in trash cans in restrooms of PC rooms, singing rooms, etc. and filmed women’s genitals, etc., and stored the videos on the hard disk of the computer at issue.”

4) Police Sergeant Nonparty 2, affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, searched the hard disk of the computer at issue on 2019. 10. 25., discovered a number of video files that appeared to have been filmed by the Defendant with a hidden camera, prepared an investigative report to that effect, and attached thereto photographs of the folder screen where the video files were stored.

5) Meanwhile, the Prosecutor filed an application for an arrest warrant against the Defendant on 2019. 10. 25., and a judge of the Uijeongbu District Court, after appointing Attorney Nonparty 3 as the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel on 2019. 10. 26., conducted a pre-arrest suspect interrogation of the Defendant and issued the arrest warrant.

6) In the second police interrogation of the suspect on 2019. 10. 29., the Defendant stated, “From around 2011 to around 2019, I installed hidden cameras in the restrooms of six places in total, including the places of offense stated in the charged facts at issue in this case, such as PC rooms, hospitals, and singing rooms, and filmed other persons’ bodies,” while specifying the places of offense by year.

7) Police Lieutenant Nonparty 1, Police Sergeant Nonparty 4, and Police Corporal Nonparty 2, affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, each took charge of one of the three hard disks built into the computer at issue and searched them in their office on 2019. 10. 30., then captured the playback scene of the illegal filming video they each found(one scene per video file) and printed it together with the captured image of the corresponding video file information(all such printouts are hereinafter referred to as the “printouts at issue”).

8) However, the investigative agency did not give advance notice to the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel concerning the above search and duplication of the computer at issue and the procedure for creation of the printouts at issue, and neither the Defendant nor the above court-appointed defense counsel participated in those procedures.

b. In light of the foregoing legal principles, when examining the above factual relationship, even if the Defendant indicated to the investigative agency an intention not to participate in the process of searching, duplicating, and printing the computer at issue, the investigative agency should have provided the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel with an opportunity to participate in the above procedure by notifying him in advance of the time and place of execution before searching, duplicating, and printing the storage medium, namely, the computer at issue, in the investigative agency’s office on 2019. 10. 30.; yet it did not do so. Therefore, the lower court’s determination that the investigative agency executing the warrant at issue violated the seizure procedure is proper, and there is no illegality in the lower court’s above determination that violated no rules of logic or experience, did not exceed the limits of free evaluation of evidence, and did not misapprehend the legal principles regarding the nature of the defense counsel’s right to participate.

c. 1) However, when all of the following circumstances ascertainable through the above factual relationship and the record are comprehensively considered, the above procedural violation by the investigative agency does not amount to an infringement of the substantive content of 적법절차, and rather there is ample room to view this as an exceptional case in which excluding the admissibility of evidence collected through the execution of the warrant at issue would produce a result contrary to the intent of the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act in establishing procedural provisions regarding 형사소송 so as to seek harmony between the principle of 적법절차 and the discovery of 실체적 진실 and thereby realize 형사사법 정의.

a) On 2019. 10. 25., the investigative agency, after confirming from the Defendant, who was then the only person entitled to participate as the 피압수자, that he did not wish to participate in the process of searching, duplicating, and printing the computer at issue, began the search of the computer at issue. At the time of the search, the Defendant had already stated that “illegal filming videos are stored on the hard disk of the computer at issue.”

b) By the time the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel was appointed, it appears that the investigative agency had already carried out the search of the computer at issue to some extent and had identified at least the location of the folder where the seized electronic information was stored.

c) The Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel had not inquired of the investigative agency about the status of execution of the warrant at issue, nor had he requested participation in the process.

d) At the time of execution of the warrant at issue, there was no established precedent or internal guideline of the investigative agency that the defense counsel appointed or selected after the commencement of the seizure and search procedure had to be separately notified in advance notwithstanding the person from whom items were seized having waived or refused participation.

e) In the course of executing the warrant at issue, the investigative agency seized videos that the Defendant had recorded, through hidden cameras installed in restrooms of PC rooms, singing rooms, etc. since around 2011, of the bodies of hundreds of victims, and indicted him for 296 of those acts(the charged facts at issue in this case). The Defendant confessed to all of those offenses in the investigative agency and in court.

2) If so, the lower court should have carefully determined, by comprehensively considering the circumstances of the seizure and search pursuant to the warrant at issue, the provisions relating to seizure procedures for electronic information in force at the time of execution of the warrant at issue, the probative purpose of the seized evidence, the circumstances that led to the procedural violation and the investigative agency’s awareness and intent regarding it, and the content and nature of the offense in this case, whether this case falls under an exception to the exclusionary rule for illegally obtained evidence.

Nevertheless, the lower court, based solely on the reasons stated in its opinion, concluded that the evidence collected through the seizure and search pursuant to the warrant at issue could not be used as evidence of guilt and found the charged facts at issue in this case not guilty. In this respect, the lower court erred by misapprehending the legal principles concerning the exception to the exclusionary rule for illegally obtained evidence and by failing to conduct the necessary examination. The Prosecutor’s ground for appeal pointing out this error is well-founded.

4. Therefore, the portion of the lower court judgment finding not guilty is reversed, and the case is remanded to the lower court for retrial and reconsideration of this portion, and it is so adjudged in accordance with the unanimous opinion of the Justices participating."}

{"[2020DO14654]": "The grounds for final appeal are examined.
1. Summary of the charges at issue
The Defendant, ① from around 2018. 1. 2. to around 2018. 12. 10., committed sexual abuse acts such as sexual harassment causing sexual humiliation against each of the 14 child and juvenile victims in the Attached Sheet of the judgment of the court below, “Amended Crime List I,” and at the same time produced obscene materials by using them; ② on 2019. 3. 1., distributed obscene materials using children and juveniles by transmitting photographs taken of the victim’s genital area, etc.; and ③ from around 2018. 6. 14. to around 2019. 1. 5., possessed a total of 229 items of obscene materials using children and juveniles.
2. Judgment concerning the seizure pursuant to the warrant in this case
A. The judgment of the court below
The court below, based on the reasons stated in its holding, determined that the procedure by which the mobile phone in this case, etc., owned by the Defendant, was seized from the Defendant’s residence pursuant to the warrant in this case was not unlawful, such as by violating the warrant principle or infringing the Defendant’s right to participate in the seizure and search proceedings.
B. Judgment of the Supreme Court
(1) Article 215(1) of the Criminal Procedure Act provides: “When necessary for a criminal investigation, the prosecutor may conduct seizure, search, or inspection by a warrant issued upon application to a judge of a district court, limited to property for which there are circumstances sufficient to suspect that the suspect committed the offense and which may be recognized as related to the case concerned.” Accordingly, if separate evidence unrelated to the criminal facts that formed the ground for issuance of the warrant is seized, such evidence cannot, in principle, be used as evidence of guilt. However, in the case of an offense that was the object of the seizure and search, or an offense related thereto, the results of such seizure and search may be used as evidence of guilt. A “crime related to the criminal suspicion stated in a seizure and search warrant” means a crime that has an objective connection with the suspected facts stated in the seizure and search warrant and a personal connection between the person subject to the warrant and the suspect. Among such crimes, “objective connection” with the suspected facts means a case directly related to the suspected facts themselves stated in the seizure and search warrant or to an offense having the same basic factual relationship as such facts; however, it may also be recognized where the evidence can be used as indirect evidence or circumstantial evidence to prove the motive and background of the offense, the means and method of the offense, the time and place of the offense, etc. At this time, objective connection should be recognized only where, taking into comprehensive consideration the content of the suspected facts stated in the seizure and search warrant, the object of the investigation, and the course of the investigation, there is a concrete and individual relationship, and such connection should not be deemed to exist merely because the suspected facts and the offense are of the same kind or similar. And the personal connection with the suspect refers to the offense of the person stated in the seizure and search warrant, but it may also be recognized in criminal cases against accomplices such as co-principals, instigators, and indirect principals, as well as necessary accomplices (see Supreme Court Decision 2016도13489, decided 2017. 1. 25.; Supreme Court Decision 2017도13458, decided 2017. 12. 5., etc.).
(2) According to the reasons of the judgment of the court below and the record, the following facts can be ascertained.
(a) The police, based on the results of seizure and search regarding the Defendant’s Facebook account through which the victim communicated, confirmed that the subscriber to the access IP address of the account through which the offender conversed with the victim via Facebook Messenger was Non-Indicted Person 1 (the Defendant’s mother). The police further confirmed that Non-Indicted Person 2 (the Defendant’s father) and Non-Indicted Person 3 (the Defendant’s younger brother) were residing together on the resident registration record of Non-Indicted Person 1. At the time, the Defendant was residing at the above Facebook access location, but because his resident registration address was different, he did not appear on Non-Indicted Person 1’s resident registration record. The police, after identifying Non-Indicted Person 3 as the suspect, applied for a seizure and search warrant, and the judge of the district court issued the instant warrant as requested by the police.
(b) In the instant warrant, the Defendant’s younger brother, “Non-Indicted Person 3,” is specified and stated as the suspect of the crime; “a. Jeollabuk-do, Jeonju-si (address omitted), b. the body of the suspect Non-Indicted Person 3 and the property possessed, owned, or held by the suspect” are specified and stated as the places, persons, or things to be searched and inspected; and “smartphones, etc., digital devices and storage media owned, possessed, held, managed, or used by the suspect Non-Indicted Person 3” are specified and stated as the items to be seized.
(c) When the police arrived at the Defendant’s residence to execute the instant warrant, the Defendant was absent because he had gone to work, and the police heard from Non-Indicted Person 1 and Non-Indicted Person 3 that the person who committed the instant charged facts was not Non-Indicted Person 3 but the Defendant.
(d) Accordingly, the police presented the instant warrant to Non-Indicted Person 1 and searched the above residence pursuant to the instant warrant and seized the instant mobile phone, etc. owned by the Defendant. At that site, the police prepared a seizure record for each of the seized items, and in the “seizure circumstances” section, they wrote: “Although Non-Indicted Person 3, residing at the Facebook access IP installation location, was identified as the suspect, upon on-site visit, the older brother, the Defendant, was residing there together in a separately divided household status, and after hearing the statements of the mother and Non-Indicted Person 3, it was confirmed that the actual suspect was the Defendant. However, because he was at work and absent at the time of execution of the warrant, the instant warrant was executed with the participation of the mother, Non-Indicted Person 1.”
(3) Examining the above facts together with the following circumstances in light of the legal principles discussed above, the seizure of the Defendant’s mobile phone, etc. by executing the instant warrant issued against a person other than the Defendant as the suspect was unlawful.
(a) In light of the spirit of due process and the warrant principle that the Constitution and the Criminal Procedure Act seek to realize, the words used by a judge when issuing a seizure and search warrant to specify the “items to be seized” must be strictly construed and must not be expansively or analogically construed to the disadvantage of the person subject to seizure, etc. (see Supreme Court Decision 2008도763, decided 2009. 3. 12., etc.).
(b) The police applied for the instant warrant in order to seize items owned or possessed by Non-Indicted Person 3, by identifying Non-Indicted Person 3 as the suspect in this case, and the judge issued the instant warrant to permit seizure of items owned or possessed by Non-Indicted Person 3 in accordance with the purpose of that application. Therefore, according to the wording of the instant warrant, the person subject to the seizure and search is Non-Indicted Person 3, and the items to be seized are limited to those owned, possessed, held, managed, or used by Non-Indicted Person 3.
(c) Even if the police heard at the seizure and search site from another person that the true offender in this case was the Defendant, they cannot seize items owned by the Defendant contrary to the wording stated in the instant warrant. Even if there may be a recognized difference between coercive measures against property and coercive measures against persons in terms such as the degree of substantiation of the criminal facts, once a warrant has been issued identifying the suspect and the person subject to seizure, it cannot be regarded as lawful and valid to execute the warrant by construing another person as the person subject to seizure.
(4) Nevertheless, the court below, for the reasons stated in its holding, determined that the execution of the instant warrant was lawful; thus, the court below erred by misapprehending the legal principles concerning the unlawfulness of seizure procedures pursuant to a warrant issued against a person other than the Defendant as the suspect.
(5) However, among the instant mobile phone, etc. seized by executing the instant warrant, the file discovered in the E310K mobile phone cannot be regarded as relating to a crime connected with the suspected facts stated in the instant warrant, and thus lacks admissibility of evidence; and because no evidence that could be used as evidence of a crime was discovered in the remainder, the court below did not use as evidence of guilt the evidence obtained from the instant mobile phone, etc. that were unlawfully seized as above.
Accordingly, since the above error by the court below did not affect the outcome of the judgment, the Defendant’s argument in this part of the grounds for final appeal cannot be accepted.
3. Judgment concerning seizure by voluntary submission
A. The seizure and search by an investigative agency of electronic information such as e-mails stored in a suspect’s information processing device, such as a computer, against an internet service user who is the suspect is permitted by the interpretation of the Criminal Procedure Act as a coercive measure in rem against the owner or possessor of the electronic information. Even where the electronic information to be seized and searched is not contained in an information processing device, such as a computer, at the search location stated in the seizure and search warrant, but is stored in a storage medium such as a remote server managed by a third party, connected to the information processing device through an information and communications network, if the investigative agency, pursuant to a warrant issued in lieu of the access authority to the suspect’s email account, enters the suspect’s email account ID and password lawfully obtained by using the information processing device, such as a computer, at the search location stated in the warrant, thereby accessing the remote storage medium in the ordinary manner by which the suspect would access it and downloading or displaying on the screen of the information processing device at the search location the suspect’s email-related electronic information stored there, this also concerns electronic information belonging to or possessed by the suspect, and therefore the seizure and search of that electronic information need not be viewed differently (see Supreme Court Decision 2017도9747, decided 2017. 11. 29.). If, when voluntarily submitting a mobile phone, the suspect voluntarily provided the investigative agency with the ID and password for accessing cloud storage, etc., with the intent to submit to the investigative agency electronic information stored not in the mobile phone but in remote locations such as the cloud, managed by a third party, then the electronic information stored in the cloud, etc. may be regarded as having been voluntarily submitted.
B. Judgment
The court below determined, for the reasons stated in its holding, that the Defendant, based on his voluntary intent, submitted the Samsung mobile phone Galaxy Note8 in his possession to the investigative agency, and voluntarily submitted to the investigative agency the SDCard stored files, Naver Cloud files, and Galaxy Note gallery files connected to the Galaxy Note8.
In light of the legal principles discussed above, the court below’s above determination is proper, and there is no error, as alleged in the grounds for final appeal, in misapprehending the legal principles concerning the unlawfulness of seizure procedures by voluntary submission, the admissibility of evidence voluntarily submitted, or the specification of the source of evidence, nor is there any error exceeding the bounds of the principle of free evaluation of evidence in violation of the rules of logic and experience.
4. Conclusion
Therefore, the appeal is dismissed, and it is so adjudged as stated in the disposition by the unanimous opinion of the Justices participating."}

{"[2021DO11170]": "We determine the grounds of appeal(상고이유서 제출기간이 지난 후에 제출된 supplemental appellate brief의 기재는 적법한 grounds of appeal를 보충하는 범위 내에서)다.
1. Regarding the Defendant’s grounds of appeal
가. The grounds of appeal challenging evidence admissibility에 대하여
1) The evidence admissibility of electronic information stored in the two PCs at OO University lecturer break room(이하 ‘이 사건 각 PC’라 한다)
가) Relevant legal principles
(1) When an information storage medium containing electronic information is voluntarily submitted, the 기준 for the scope of seizure of electronic information and relevance
헌법과 형사소송법이 구현하고자 하는 due process, warrant requirement, and the principle of proportionality는 물론, 사생활의 비밀과 자유, 정보에 대한 자기결정권 및 재산권의 보호라는 관점에서 정보저장매체 내 electronic information이 가지는 중요성에 비추어 볼 때, information storage medium을 voluntarily submitting 하는 사람이 거기에 담긴 electronic information을 지정하거나 제출 범위를 한정하는 취지로 한 의사표시는 strictly construed 되어야 하고, 확인되지 않은 제출자의 의사를 investigation agency가 함부로 추단하는 것은 허용될 수 없다. Therefore, 수사기관이 제출자의 의사를 쉽게 확인할 수 있음에도 이를 확인하지 않은 채 specific criminal suspicion과 related된 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 혼재된 information storage medium을 voluntarily received한 경우, 그 information storage medium에 저장된 electronic information 전부가 voluntarily submitted and seized된 것으로 취급할 수는 없다.
전자정보를 seize하고자 하는 investigation agency가 information storage medium과 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 voluntary submission 방식으로 seize할 때, 제출자의 구체적인 submission scope에 관한 의사를 제대로 확인하지 않는 등의 사유로 인해 voluntary submitter의 의사에 따른 electronic information seizure의 object and scope가 명확하지 않거나 이를 알 수 없는 경우에는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 동기가 된 criminal suspicion과 관련되고 이를 증명할 수 있는 최소한의 가치가 있는 electronic information에 한하여 seizure의 대상이 된다. Here, electronic information related to the criminal suspicion에는 범죄혐의사실 그 자체 또는 그와 basic factual relationship가 동일한 범행과 직접 related된 것은 물론 범행 motive and background, means and method, time and place 등을 증명하기 위한 indirect evidence나 circumstantial evidence 등으로 사용될 수 있는 것도 포함될 수 있다. However, such relevance는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 동기가 된 criminal suspicion의 내용과 investigation object, investigation course, voluntary submission process 등을 종합하여 concrete and individual nexus가 있는 경우에만 인정되고, 단순히 criminal suspicion과 same kind or similar offense라는 사유만으로 relevant하다고 할 것은 아니다(대법원 2021. 11. 18. 선고 2016도348 전원합의체 판결 등 참조).
(2) Guarantee of the right to participate in the search, copying, and printing of electronic information
압수의 대상이 되는 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 혼재된 information storage medium이나 그 copy를 voluntarily received한 investigation agency가 그 information storage medium 등을 prosecutor’s office 등으로 옮겨 이를 search, copy, and print하는 경우, 그와 같은 일련의 process에서 형사소송법 제219조, 제121조에서 규정하는 피압수·수색 당사자(이하 ‘피압수자’라 한다)나 그 defense counsel에게 participation opportunity를 보장하고 seized electronic information의 file details가 specified된 seizure inventory를 prepare and deliver하며 criminal suspicion과 unrelated한 electronic information의 arbitrary copying 등을 막기 위한 적절한 measures를 취하는 등 warrant requirement principle과 due process를 준수하여야 한다. If such measures were not taken, then, 피압수자 측이 participation하지 않겠다는 의사를 expressly indicated했거나 voluntary submission의 purpose and course 또는 procedure violation이 이루어진 과정의 nature and content 등에 비추어 피압수자 측에 procedural participation를 보장한 purpose가 substantially infringed되었다고 볼 수 없을 정도의 special circumstances가 없는 이상 seizure/search는 lawful하다고 평가할 수 없고, 비록 investigation agency가 information storage medium 또는 copy에서 criminal suspicion과 related된 electronic information만을 copy or print하였다 하더라도 달리 볼 것은 아니다.
Furthermore, victim 등 third party가 suspect의 ownership or control에 속하는 information storage medium을 warrant 없이 voluntarily submitted한 경우에는, 실질적 피압수자인 suspect가 investigation agency로 하여금 그 electronic information 전부를 무제한 search하는 데 consent한 것으로 보기 어려울 뿐만 아니라 suspect himself or herself가 voluntarily submitted한 경우에도 suspect’s right to participate 등이 guaranteed되어야 하는 것과 견주어 보더라도 special circumstances가 없는 한 형사소송법 제219조, 제121조, 제129조에 따라 suspect에게 participation right를 guarantee하고 seized electronic information list를 deliver하는 등 suspect의 procedural rights를 보장하기 위한 appropriate measures가 이루어져야 한다(위 대법원 2016도348 전원합의체 판결 등 참조).
In this way, information storage medium을 voluntarily submitted한 피압수자에 더하여 voluntary submitter 아닌 suspect에게도 participation right가 guaranteed되어야 하는 ‘information storage medium belonging to or under the control of the suspect’는, suspect가 seizure/search 당시 또는 그와 temporally proximate한 시기까지 해당 information storage medium을 actually dominated and managed하면서 그 information storage medium 내 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive authority to manage and dispose를 보유·행사하고, 달리 이를 자신의 의사에 따라 third party에게 transfer하거나 waive하지 아니한 경우로서, suspect를 그 information storage medium에 저장된 electronic information에 대하여 substantially subject to seizure로 평가할 수 있는 경우를 말한다. Whether this applies는 민사법상 권리의 귀속에 따른 legal or ex post facto judgment가 아니라 seizure/search 당시 externally and objectively recognizable factual condition을 기준으로 판단하여야 한다. 이러한 information storage medium의 externally and objectively dominant and managerial condition과 별도로 단지 suspect나 다른 third party가 과거 그 information storage medium의 이용 내지 개별 electronic information의 생성·이용 등에 관여한 사실이 있다거나 그 과정에서 생성된 electronic information에 의해 identified되는 data subject에 해당한다는 사정만으로 그들을 actually subjected to seizure/search한 party로 취급하여야 하는 것은 아니다.
나) Found facts
원심판결 이유 및 적법하게 채택된 evidence에 의하면 다음 사실을 알 수 있다.
(1) 검찰은 2019. 9. 10.경까지 피고인에 대한 2012. 9. 7. ○○대 총장 명의 표창장에 관한 사문서위조(서울중앙지방법원 2019고합738호 공소사실), 공소외 1의 △△대 및 □□대 의학전문대학원 지원 과정에서의 위 표창장 제출로 인한 forged private document uttering, 위 표창장 및 그 밖에 허위 경력의 기재로 인한 □□대 의학전문대학원 입학사정 업무에 관한 obstruction of official duties by deception 등 공소외 1의 medical graduate school fraud application 관련 offenses를 criminal suspicion facts로 하여 피고인의 ○○대 교수연구실, ◇◇◇고 등에 대한 search-and-seizure warrant execution 등의 investigation을 진행하였다.
(2) 공소외 2는 2019. 3. 1.부터 ○○대 ☆☆학부 assistant를 맡아 ○○대 강사휴게실 및 그 안에 있는 물건들을 전임자로부터 인계받아 관리하는 업무를 담당하고 있었다. The PCs at issue were stored in the lecturer break room without any separate marking as to ownership or legal relations.
(3) The basic purport of 공소외 2 statement regarding ownership and management status of the PCs at issue는 전임자로부터 ‘퇴직자들이 놔두고 간 물건이니 학교당국에 반납하거나 알아서 처리하라.’고 들어서 그와 같이 알고 있었다는 것이다. Furthermore, according to 공소외 2’s statement, if there were a professor who wished to use the PCs at issue, he or she intended to provide them.
(4) 피고인 측도 제1심 제1회 공판기일에서 이 사건 각 PC를 피고인이 사용한 사실이 없고 ○○대에서 shared PC로만 사용되었다고 주장하였고, 그 후 원심에 이르기까지 주장이 수차례 변경되기는 하였으나, 그 basic position은 이 사건 각 PC를 ○○대에서 shared PC로 사용하다가 피고인이 일정 기간 자신의 residence 등으로 가져가 사용하였으며 2016. 12.경 다시 ○○대로 가져다 놓았다는 것으로, 이는 이 사건 압수·수색 당시 이 사건 각 PC의 objective, actual dominion, custody, and attribution of authority to manage and dispose가 ○○대 측에 있었던 상태와 부합한다.
(5) 공소외 2는 ○○대 측의 협조지시를 토대로 2019. 9. 10. 검찰수사관들에게 ○○대 ☆☆학부 건물 내부를 안내하는 등으로 investigation에 협조하던 중 검찰수사관의 요청에 따라 검찰수사관이 이 사건 각 PC 중 1대를 구동하여 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 확인할 수 있도록 하였다. In the course of the prosecutorial investigator’s search of the electronic information stored in that PC in the presence of 공소외 2, a folder related to 공소외 3 was discovered, and while the search continued, the PC emitted a “pop” sound and powered off. Thereupon, the prosecutorial investigator asked 공소외 2 and 공소외 4, the Director of the Administrative Support Office who oversaw the management of OO University’s property, whether they could discontinue the search at the scene and submit the PCs at issue to the prosecution.
(6) 이에 공소외 2와 공소외 4는 검찰수사관의 요청에 응하여 voluntarily submitted the PCs at issue, and in that process they entered their personal details, signed, and affixed their seals/thumbprints on the “Consent to Voluntary Submission” form, which stated that they were voluntarily submitting the PCs at issue and listed the PCs at issue in the section for voluntarily submitted items.
(7) At that time, the prosecutorial investigator asked 공소외 2 and 공소외 4 whether they wished to attend the imaging and search of the PCs at issue, extraction of electronic information, and the like, but they replied that they would not attend. Thereafter, 공소외 2 and 공소외 4 entered their personal details, signed, and affixed their seals/thumbprints in the section for “the person subject to seizure (voluntary submitter)” of the “Confirmation of Whether to Attend the Submission and Imaging, etc. of an Information Storage Medium” form(이하 ‘참관여부 확인서’라 한다), which stated in substance that they would not attend the hard copy/imaging of the voluntarily submitted information storage medium, search and copying( printing) of electronic information, and the like.
(8) 검찰수사관은 공소외 2, 공소외 4로부터 위 “Consent to Voluntary Submission” and “Confirmation of Whether to Attend”를 each received하고, 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 이 사건 각 PC에 관한 “Seizure Inventory Receipt”를 deliver한 후 이 사건 각 PC를 대검찰청으로 가져갔다. 그 과정에서 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 specific scope of submission에 관한 의사를 추가로 다시 확인하지는 않았다.
(9) 그 후 검찰은 이 사건 각 PC에 대한 imaging and forensic work를 하여 electronic information을 추출하였고, 이에 따라 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장에 관한 사문서위조 범행이 2013. 6. 16.경 이 사건 각 PC 중 1대를 이용하여 이루어진 정황이 발견되었다.
(10) 이에 검찰은 2019. 11. 27. 서울중앙지방법원 2019고합738호 사건에서 ‘피고인이 2012. 9. 7. ○○대에서 ○○대 총장 직인을 임의로 날인하여 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 위조하였다.’는 기존 공소사실을, ‘피고인이 2013. 6. 16. 주거지에서 PC를 이용하여 전자파일로 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 위조하였다.’는 취지로 amendment of the indictment 신청을 하였으나, 재판부로부터 공소사실의 identity가 인정되지 않는다는 이유로 허가를 받지 못하자, 2019. 12. 17. 서울중앙지방법원 2019고합1050호로 위 amendment 신청과 같은 내용의 공소사실로 additional prosecution를 하였다.
(11) 검찰은 2020. 2. 11. 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted and seized된 electronic information의 file details가 specified된 list를 교부하였다.
(12) 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information은 2013. 6. 16. 사문서위조(서울중앙지방법원 2019고합1050호 공소사실) 등 이 사건 공소사실 중 공소외 1의 의학전문대학원 부정지원 관련 범행의 evidence로 사용되었다.
다) Judgment
(1) Voluntary submission of the PCs at issue
앞서 본 법리에 비추어 위 인정 사실을 살펴보면, 이 사건 각 PC는 2019. 9. 10. 당시 특정인이 이를 특정 용도로 exclusive use하고 있던 것이 아니라, ○○대 관계자가 ○○대에서 shared PC로 사용하거나 기타 방법으로 임의처리할 것을 전제로 3년 가까이 강사휴게실 내에 보관하면서 ○○대 ☆☆학부 조교가 이 사건 각 PC에 대한 custody and management 업무를 수행하고 있던 것으로, 당시 위 보관·관리 업무의 담당자인 조교 공소외 2와 ○○대 물품 관리를 총괄하는 행정지원처장 공소외 4가 ○○대 측의 입장을 반영한 voluntary intent에 따라 이 사건 각 PC를 검찰에 제출한 것이라고 인정된다.
(2) Necessity and relevance of the seizure of electronic information stored in the PCs at issue
(가) 앞서 본 법리에 비추어 보면, 원심이 information storage medium과 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 voluntarily received and seized하는 경우에는 seizure object가 그 necessity and relevance가 인정되는 범위 내로 제한되는 것이 아니라고 전제하고, 수사기관이 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 specific scope of submission에 관한 의사를 확인하지 않았더라도 이 사건 각 PC와 거기에 저장된 electronic information 전부가 voluntarily submitted된 것으로 볼 수 있다고 단정한 것은 잘못이다. 이 사건 각 PC는 피고인에 대한 criminal suspicion facts 관련 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 mixed된 information storage medium으로서, 이 경우 확인되지 않은 submitter의 의사를 임의로 추단하여 PC에 저장된 electronic information 전부가 voluntarily submitted and seized된 것으로 취급하는 것은 원칙적으로 허용될 수 없다.
(나) 이처럼 voluntary submitter의 의사에 따른 electronic information seizure의 object and scope를 명확하게 알 수 없는 경우에는 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure의 동기가 된 criminal suspicion facts와 관련되고 이를 증명할 수 있는 최소한의 가치가 있는 electronic information에 한하여 seizure의 대상이 된다고 보아야 한다.
이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission 당시 피고인은 이미 공소외 1의 △△대 및 □□대 의학전문대학원 지원 과정에서 위조된 ○○대 총장 명의 표창장을 제출하였다는 취지의 forged private document uttering, 위 표창장 및 그 밖에 허위 경력의 기재로 인한 □□대 의학전문대학원 입학사정 업무에 관한 obstruction of official duties by deception 등의 criminal suspicion facts로 수사를 받고 있었다.
따라서 피고인이 2013. 6. 16. 이 사건 각 PC 중 1대를 이용하여 위 표창장 위조행위를 하는 등 공소외 1의 의학전문대학원 부정지원 과정에서 이 사건 각 PC를 사용하여 생성된 electronic information은 위 criminal suspicion facts에 관한 범행의 motive and background, means and method 등을 증명하기 위한 concrete and individual nexus 있는 evidence에 해당한다고 볼 수 있고, 그 밖에 이 사건 investigation object and course, voluntary submission process 등을 종합해 보더라도 그 necessity and relevance를 인정하기에 충분하다.
(다) Ultimately, among the electronic information stored in the PCs at issue, the portions used as evidence of the offenses related to 공소외 1’s fraudulent application to the medical graduate school among the facts charged in this case have both necessity and relevance for seizure pursuant to voluntary submission; thus, the lower court’s legal error as noted above does not affect the result of the judgment.
(3) Guarantee of the right to participate in the process of search and extraction of the electronic information stored in the PCs at issue
(가) 앞서 본 법리에 비추어 보면, 원심이 information storage medium 및 저장된 electronic information을 voluntarily received and seized하는 경우에는 그 electronic information search 등의 과정에서 원칙적으로 피압수자 측이나 피의자 측에게 participation right를 인정할 여지가 없다는 취지로 설시한 것은 잘못이다.
이 사건 각 PC는 피고인에 대한 criminal suspicion facts와 관련된 electronic information과 그렇지 않은 electronic information이 mixed된 information storage medium으로서, 검찰이 이를 공소외 2, 공소외 4로부터 voluntarily received하여 seize한 후 대검찰청 국가디지털포렌식센터로 옮겨 거기에 저장된 electronic information을 search하고 extract하는 등의 process에서 원칙적으로 피압수자인 ○○대 측에 participation opportunity를 보장하여야 하기 때문이다.
(나) 그런데 위 인정 사실에서 살펴본 바와 같이 이 사건 각 PC에서 criminal suspicion facts와 관련된 electronic information을 search하고 extract하는 일련의 경과에 비추어 검찰이 피압수자 측인 공소외 2, 공소외 4에게 participation intent를 확인하고 opportunity를 부여하였으나 피압수자 측이 이를 waive하였다고 인정되므로, 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information의 seizure/search procedure에 피압수자 측의 participation right를 보장하지 아니한 defect가 있다고 할 수는 없다.
Furthermore, 압수·수색 대상인 information storage medium 내 electronic information의 왜곡이나 혐의사실과 무관한 electronic information의 arbitrary copying 등을 막기 위한 appropriate measures의 일환으로 피압수자 측에 절차 참여를 보장한 취지(대법원 2011. 5. 26. 자 2009모1190 결정, 대법원 2015. 7. 16. 자 2011모1839 전원합의체 결정 등 참조)에 비추어 이 사건 압수·수색의 entire process를 살펴볼 때, 공소외 2에게 이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure 당시 criminal suspicion facts에 대한 detailed notice 등의 additional measures가 이루어지지 않았다는 등 피고인이 주장하는 사유만으로는 피압수자 측에 procedural participation를 보장한 purpose가 substantially infringed되었다고 볼 수도 없다.
(다) Also, 앞서 본 법리를 토대로 위 인정 사실을 살펴보면, 이 사건 각 PC의 voluntary submission에 따른 seizure/search 당시 externally and objectively recognizable factual condition을 기준으로 볼 때, 이 사건 각 PC나 거기에 저장된 electronic information이 피고인의 ownership or management에 속한 경우에 해당한다고 인정되지 않는다. Rather, ○○대 측이 이 사건 각 PC를 2016. 12.경 이후 3년 가까이 강사휴게실 내에 보관하면서 현실적으로 지배·관리하는 한편, 이를 shared PC로 사용하거나 임의처리 등의 조치를 할 수 있었던 것으로 보이는 등의 objective circumstances에 비추어 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information 전반에 관하여 당시 ○○대 측이 comprehensive authority to manage and dispose를 사실상 보유·행사하고 있는 상태에 있었다고 인정된다.
피고인이 2016. 12.경 이전에 이 사건 각 PC를 피고인의 residence 등으로 가져가 exclusive use한 바 있다거나, 2016. 12.경 이후 이 사건 각 PC가 보관된 장소인 강사휴게실이 피고인의 professor research room 주변에 있었다는 점 등 피고인이 주장하는 모든 사정들을 고려해 보더라도, 피고인의 actual domination and management status와 이에 저장된 electronic information 전반에 관한 management and disposal authority가 이 사건 압수·수색 당시까지 유지되고 있었다고 볼 수 없으므로, 피고인을 이 사건 압수·수색에 관하여 substantially subject to seizure/search로 평가할 수 있는 경우에 해당하지 아니한다.
따라서 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 seizure/search는 위 대법원 2016도348 전원합의체 판결이 설시한 법리에 따르더라도 suspect에게 participation right를 guarantee하여야 하는 case에는 해당하지 아니한다.
(라) Meanwhile, 피고인은 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information의 seizure/search 과정에서 피고인 측을 electronic information의 ‘data subject’라고 하면서 이를 근거로 피고인 측에게 participation right가 보장되었어야 한다는 취지의 주장도 한다. 앞서 본 바와 같이, suspect의 involvement 없이 voluntarily submitted된 information storage medium 내의 electronic information search 등의 과정에서 suspect가 participation right를 주장하기 위해서는 information storage medium에 대한 actual domination and control status와 그 내부 electronic information 전반에 관한 exclusive authority to manage and dispose의 보유가 전제되어야 한다. 따라서 이러한 domination and control 등의 상태와 무관하게 individual electronic information의 creation/use 등에 관여한 자들 혹은 그 과정에서 생성된 electronic information에 의해 identified되는 사람으로서 그 information의 subject가 되는 사람들에게까지 모두 participation right를 인정하는 취지가 아니므로, 위 주장은 받아들이기 어렵다.
(마) Ultimately, 이 사건 각 PC에 저장된 electronic information에 대한 search and extraction 등의 process에서 피압수자 측에게는 participation right가 guaranteed되었고, 이에 더하여 피고인 측의 participation right까지 보장되어야 하는 경우에는 해당하지 아니하므로, 원심판단의 이 부분 잘못 역시 판결 결과에 influence가 없다.
(4) The evidence admissibility of electronic information extracted from the PCs at issue
원심은 판시와 같은 이유를 들어 검찰이 이 사건 각 PC의 possession and custody자인 ○○대 측으로부터 위 각 PC를 voluntarily received and seized한 것은 unlawful investigation after indictment에 해당하지 않고, 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information에 관하여 피고인 측의 consent를 받아야만 그 evidence admissibility가 인정된다고 할 수 없으며, 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information 및 그 출력한 문건과 original과의 identity and integrity가 증명되었다고 보아 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 electronic information이 evidence로 사용될 수 있다고 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 앞서 본 법리와 위 인정 사실에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 이유 설시에 일부 부적절한 부분이 있으나 이 사건 각 PC에서 extracted된 evidence의 evidence admissibility를 인정한 원심의 conclusion은 proper하고, grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 공소제기 후 강제수사, 제3자 consent에 의한 voluntary submitted items의 seizure/search에 있어서 data subject의 consent 필요성, voluntary submitted items의 seizure에 있어서 custodian의 status and voluntariness, information storage medium에 대한 voluntary submitted items seizure에 있어서 형사소송법 제219조 준용규정의 범위, original과의 identity and integrity, warrant requirement 등에 관한 legal principles를 misapprehend하여 판결에 영향을 미친 잘못이 없다.
2) Evidence admissibility of the result of execution of the search-and-seizure warrants for tracing financial accounts
가) 원심은 판시와 같은 이유를 들어 금융계좌추적용 압수·수색영장의 집행에 있어서 검찰이 형사사법정보통신망을 통해 여러 금융기관에 금융거래정보 제공요구서, 영장 사본 및 수사관 신분증 사본을 electronic fax 방식으로 송신하고 금융기관으로부터 email이나 fax로 금융거래자료를 수신하여, 수신한 금융거래자료를 분석한 후 최종적으로 사건과 관련된 selected data list를 작성한 다음 금융기관에 직접 방문하여 영장 원본을 제시하고 선별자료를 storage medium에 저장하는 한편 압수목록을 교부하고 압수조서를 작성하는 일련의 execution methods는 헌법과 형사소송법이 정한 seizure/search procedure에 위배되지 아니하고, 이 사건에서 그러한 방법으로 수집되어 evidence로 제출된 financial transaction data는 evidence admissibility가 있다고 판단하였다.
나) However, as a matter of principle, investigation agency’s seizure and search must be based on a search-and-seizure warrant issued by a judge, and the original warrant must be presented to the person receiving the disposition(see, e.g., Supreme Court Decisions 2015도10648, 2018도2841 등). Accordingly, even in executing a search-and-seizure warrant for tracing financial accounts, if the investigation agency did not present the original warrant in advance to the financial institution before receiving financial transaction data from it, such method cannot in principle be regarded as a lawful execution method.
다만 수사기관이 금융기관에 「금융실명거래 및 비밀보장에 관한 법률」(이하 ‘금융실명법’이라 한다) 제4조 제2항에 따라서 financial transaction information에 대하여 영장 사본을 첨부하여 그 제공을 요구한 결과 금융기관으로부터 회신받은 financial transaction data가 해당 영장의 execution object and scope에 포함되어 있고, 이러한 facsimile transmission or electronic transmission 방식의 financial transaction information request 및 data response의 전 과정이 해당 금융기관의 voluntary cooperation에 따른 것이며, 그 자료 중 criminal suspicion facts와 관련된 financial transaction을 selected하는 절차를 거친 후 최종적으로 영장 원본을 제시하고 위와 같이 selected financial transaction data에 대한 seizure procedure가 집행된 경우로서, 그 과정이 금융실명법에서 정한 방식에 따라 이루어지고 달리 due process와 warrant requirement 원칙을 evade하려는 intent에서 이루어진 것이라고 볼 만한 circumstances가 없어, 이러한 일련의 과정을 전체적으로 ‘하나의 영장에 기하여 적시에 원본을 제시하고 이를 토대로 압수·수색하는 것’으로 평가할 수 있는 경우에 한하여, exceptionally lawful execution method에 해당한다고 볼 수 있다.
다) 이러한 법리에 비추어 이 사건 각 금융계좌추적용 압수·수색영장의 집행 과정을 살펴보면, 수사기관이 금융기관으로부터 financial transaction data를 수신하기에 앞서 영장 원본을 사전에 제시하지 않았다고 하더라도 그 후 criminal suspicion facts와 관련된 자료의 selected process를 거친 후 최종적으로 영장 원본을 제시하고 그 selected 자료를 직접 압수하는 일련의 과정이 전체적으로 하나의 영장에 기하여 적시에 원본을 제시하고 이를 토대로 영장의 당초 execution object and scope 내에서 이를 seizure/search한 것으로 평가할 수 있는 경우에 해당하고, 수사기관이 due process와 warrant requirement 원칙을 잠탈하려는 의도에서 위와 같은 방법으로 집행하였다고 인정할 만한 circumstances도 보이지 아니한다.
따라서 이 사건 각 금융계좌추적용 압수·수색영장의 집행 과정에서 확보된 financial transaction data의 evidence admissibility가 인정된다고 한 원심의 결론은 proper하고, grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 영장 제시 방법 및 압수·수색절차의 적법성, 이 부분 압수물 및 secondary evidence의 evidence admissibility에 관한 legal principles misapprehension, 심리미진 등으로 판결에 영향을 미친 잘못이 없다.

바. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning instigation of evidence destruction
원심은 판시와 같은 이유를 들어 피고인이 이 부분 공소사실 기재와 같이 공소외 3 또는 피고인의 형사사건 등에 관한 evidence인 공소외 5 관련 자료를 destroy하려는 intent를 가지고, 공소외 6, 공소외 7과 conspiracy하여 (회사명 3 생략) 직원들에 대한 evidence destruction instigation이 이루어지도록 하였으며, 이에 대한 공동가공의 의사와 functional control over the act가 인정되고, 이러한 피고인의 행위는 defense right의 abuse에 해당한다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 guilty로 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 관련 법리와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 논리와 경험의 법칙을 위반하여 자유심증주의의 한계를 벗어나거나 증거인멸교사의 공동정범의 성립, ‘교사의 고의’와 ‘교사에 대한 공동가공의 의사’, 증거인멸죄의 ‘형사사건 또는 징계사건에 관한 증거’ 및 방어권 남용에 관한 legal principles misapprehension, 이유모순 등의 잘못이 없다.
사. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning instigation of evidence concealment
원심은 판시와 같은 이유를 들어 피고인이 이 부분 공소사실 기재와 같이 공소외 8에게 피고인의 residence PC storage medium과 피고인의 ○○대 professor research room PC main unit에 관한 evidence concealment을 지시한 사실이 인정되고, 이러한 피고인의 행위는 evidence concealment의 공동정범이 아니라 instigation에 해당하며, 공소외 8은 피고인의 지시에 따라 evidence concealment을 결의한 것일 뿐 공동가공의 의사가 인정될 수 없다고 보아 이 부분 공소사실을 무죄로 판단한 제1심판결을 파기하고 guilty로 판단하였다.
원심판결 이유를 관련 법리와 적법하게 채택한 evidence에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 grounds of appeal 주장과 같이 논리와 경험의 법칙을 위반하여 자유심증주의의 한계를 벗어나거나 증거은닉죄의 ‘기수’와 ‘정범’ 인정, 공동정범 및 교사범의 구별 기준인 ‘functional control over the act’, 증거은닉의 ‘execution commencement’, 공소외 8의 ‘common intent to act jointly’에 관한 legal principles misapprehension의 잘못이 없다.
2. Regarding the Prosecutor’s grounds of appeal
원심은 판시와 같은 이유로 이 사건 공소사실 중 △△대 ◁대 ▷▷▷▷▷센터장 명의 인턴십 확인서에 관한 주위적 공소사실인 forged official document uttering, 업무상횡령, (회사명 1 생략) 실물주권 12만 주 장외매수에 관한 미공개중요정보 이용으로 인한 자본시장법 위반 및「범죄수익은닉의 규제 및 처벌 등에 관한 법률」위반, 거짓 변경보고로 인한 자본시장법 위반, (회사명 2 생략) 계좌(계좌번호 생략)를 이용한 금융실명법 위반, evidence forgery instigation 부분에 대하여 crime proof가 없다고 보아 이를 무죄로 판단하거나 무죄를 선고한 제1심판결을 그대로 유지하였다.
원심판결 이유를 관련 법리와 record에 비추어 살펴보면, 원심의 판단에 논리와 경험의 법칙을 위반하여 자유심증주의의 한계를 벗어나거나, forged official document uttering offense의 intent, embezzlement in the course of duties offense의 unlawful appropriation intent, undisclosed material information use로 인한 자본시장법 위반 offense의 성립, 공동정범의 성립, 금융실명법 위반죄의 ‘탈법 목적’, instigation conduct에 관한 legal principles misapprehension, 판단누락 등의 잘못이 없다.
3. Conclusion
Therefore, all appeals are dismissed, and the judgment is rendered in accordance with the unanimous opinion of the Justices who participated, as stated in the order."}

{"[2022DO7453]": "상고이유를 판단한다.

1. final appeal에서의 법리오해 주장에 관한 판단
가. 관련 법리
전자정보가 저장된 digital storage medium의 중요성은 due process, warrant requirement, 비례의 원칙과 함께 사생활의 비밀과 자유, 정보에 대한 자기결정권에서 나온다. 압수 대상 electronic information과 무관한 electronic information이 혼재된 정보저장매체를 voluntary submission 받은 수사기관이 이를 옮겨 탐색·복제·출력할 때에는 형사소송법 제219조, 제121조에 따른 압수·수색영장의 집행에서 participation right를 보장하고 압수목록을 교부하는 등 적절한 조치를 취해야 한다. 그렇지 않으면 특별한 사정이 없는 한 적법한 seizure and search라고 보기 어렵고, 수사기관이 관련 정보만 복제·출력하였더라도 달리 볼 것은 아니다.

다만 participation right가 보장되어야 하는 substantive person subject to seizure는 압수·수색 시점 또는 그에 가까운 시기에 해당 정보저장매체를 실제로 지배·관리하면서 전속적 관리처분권을 보유·행사한 사람을 말하고, 이는 민사법상 권리귀속이 아니라 외형적·객관적 상태로 판단한다. 단순히 과거에 이용에 관여했거나 그 과정에서 생성된 정보의 정보주체라는 사정만으로는 부족하다.

나. 인정 사실
수사기관은 2019. 8. 27.경 공소외 1, 공소외 2 자녀의 입시·학사 비리 의혹, 사모펀드 투자 비리 의혹, (명칭 1 생략) 학원 비리 의혹 등으로 압수·수색을 시작하였다. 공소외 1은 2019. 8. 31.경 공소외 3에게 자신과 가족이 쓰던 3개의 정보저장매체를 주면서 수사가 끝날 때까지 숨기라고 지시하였고, 공소외 3은 이를 은닉하였다가 2019. 9. 11. 수사기관에 임의제출하였다. 수사기관은 공소외 3과 그 변호인에게는 참여 기회를 부여했지만 공소외 1 등에게는 이를 하지 않았다.

다. 판단
이 사건에서는 공소외 3이 증거은닉죄 피의자로서 이 사건 hard disk drive를 임의제출한 이상, 그와 별개로 공소외 1 등에게까지 participation right를 보장해야 한다고 보기 어렵다. 공소외 3은 은닉행위의 직접적 대상물이자 자신의 범죄혐의와 관련된 증거를 제출한 사람으로서 실질적 이해관계와 참여의 이익이 있다. 또한 그는 은닉 경위와 자신의 지위상 그 무렵 이 사건 하드디스크를 현실적으로 점유하고 있었고, 저장정보에 대한 관리처분권도 사실상 행사할 수 있었다. 반면 공소외 1은 은닉 목적을 위해 하드디스크를 공소외 3에게 넘기며 외형적 연관성을 끊고 사실상 지배·관리권을 공소외 3에게 이전한 것으로 볼 수 있다. 따라서 원심이 공소외 1 등의 참여권을 인정하지 않고 이 사건 전자정보의 증거능력을 인정한 것은 정당하다.

2. 그 밖의 상고이유에 관한 판단
원심은 관련 법리와 적법하게 채택된 증거에 비추어 사실인정을 하였고, 논리와 경험칙을 위반하여 자유심증주의의 한계를 벗어나거나 압수물과 피의사실의 관련성, 공소권남용, 허위성에 대한 무죄추정과 증거재판주의, 업무방해죄의 위계와 결과발생 위험성, 고의와 공동정범, 2차 증거의 증거능력 등에 관한 법리를 오해한 잘못이 없다.

3. 결론
그러므로 상고를 기각한다. 이 판결에는 대법관 민유숙, 대법관 이흥구, 대법관 오경미의 dissenting opinion이 있고, 대법관 안철상, 대법관 노태악, 대법관 천대엽의 concurring opinion도 있다.

4. 반대의견의 요지
반대의견은, 실질적 피압수자는 형식적 피압수자와 별개로 정보저장매체의 소유·관리자로서 무관정보에 대한 탐색·복제로부터 사생활의 비밀과 자유를 보호받아야 하며, 본범이 증거를 은닉하기 위해 제3자에게 넘긴 경우에도 본범에게 participation right를 보장해야 한다고 본다. 특히 digital storage medium의 소유·관리자가 따로 존재하는 경우 그 사람을 실질적 피압수자로 보아야 하고, 본범과 증거은닉범의 구조에서도 본범이 여전히 전자정보에 대한 전속적 관리처분권을 잃지 않았다고 평가할 수 있다고 주장한다.

그러나 majority opinion은, 증거은닉범인 공소외 3이 스스로의 범죄혐의와 관련하여 하드디스크를 임의제출한 사안에서는 그에게 participation right를 보장하는 것으로 절차적 적법성이 충족되고, 공소외 1 등은 이미 전속적 지배·관리권을 공소외 3에게 넘긴 이상 실질적 피압수자에 해당하지 않는다고 본다. 2016도348 전원합의체 판결과 2021도11170 판결의 법리는 피압수자와 실질적 이해관계인을 보호하기 위한 것이지만, 이 사건처럼 임의제출자 자신이 피의자인 경우까지 본범에게 참여권을 확장할 필요는 없다는 취지다.

5. 보충의견의 취지
보충의견은, 전자정보 압수·수색에서 participation right는 영장주의와 적법절차를 구현하기 위한 procedural right이고, 범죄혐의사실을 기준으로 유관정보와 무관정보를 구별하여 실질적 피압수자를 정하는 것이 선례의 흐름에 맞다고 설명한다. 또 정보저장매체의 현실적 소지·보관자와 관리처분권자가 분리되는 경우에도 객관적·외형적 상태를 기준으로 판단해야 하며, 이 사건에서는 공소외 3이 현실적 점유자이자 실질적 이해관계자이므로 그 참여만으로 적법성이 확보된다고 본다.

6. 결론적 정리
이 사건의 핵심은, 증거은닉범이 수사기관에 임의제출한 digital storage medium의 탐색·복제·출력 과정에서 누구에게 participation right를 줄 것인가이다. majority는 공소외 3에게의 보장으로 충분하다고 보고, dissent는 본범인 공소외 1 등에게도 보장해야 한다고 본다. 원심은 majority의 입장을 취해 증거능력을 인정하였고, 상고는 이유 없다.
"}

question: Among the explanations concerning 신체의 자유, which of the following are all incorrect? (Where there is a dispute, according to precedents) (a) A statutory provision that allows the 형의 감경 or 면제 for a person who has served all or part of the sentence in a foreign country does not infringe 신체의 자유 because it falls within the scope of the legislator's 입법형성권. (b) Unlike 형벌, a security measure is based on the actor's 장래 재범위험성, and since whether to pronounce a security measure is determined by assessing the 재범위험성 at the time of trial rather than at the time of the act, even if a certain security measure has a strong 형벌적 성격 and restricts 신체의 자유 to a degree equivalent to deprivation of personal liberty, the 형벌불소급원칙 does not apply. (c) Excluding foreigners detained pursuant to the ｢출입국관리법｣ from the scope of detainees who may file a petition for relief under the ｢인신보호법｣ deprives them of the opportunity to contest the 적부 of their detention under the ｢인신보호법｣ and thus infringes 신체의 자유. (d) A statutory provision that states that a person who has received a 강제퇴거명령 may be detained in a 보호시설 until deportation becomes possible if the person cannot be immediately deported outside the Republic of Korea infringes 신체의 자유 because it emphasizes only 행정의 편의성 and 획일성. (e) The right to meet and communicate with counsel, in light of the 헌법 규정, is a fundamental right concerning 신체의 자유 limited only to suspects or accused persons who have been 체포 or 구속, and it cannot be said that those provisions derive a right of counsel to meet and communicate with an arrested or detained suspect or accused person.

{"[2010HEONGA82]": "[Appendix] 관련 조항

Former Act on the Attachment, etc. of Electronic Devices for 위치추적 of Specific Criminal Offenders (as amended by Act No. 10257 on 2010. 4. 15., and before amendment by Act No. 11558 on 2012. 12. 18.)

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to protect the people from 특정범죄 by taking the 추가조치 of attaching to the body an electronic device that can 추적 the offender’s 행적 and determine his or her 위치, for the prevention of 재범 by 특정범죄자 and for their 재사회화 through the correction of their 성행.

Article 2 (Definitions) The definitions of terms used in this Act are as follows:
4. “Location-tracking electronic device (hereinafter referred to as ‘electronic device’)” means a series of 기계적 설비, as determined by 대통령령, that identifies 위치 or detects a 이동경로 by using the principle of emitting and tracking 전자파.

Article 4 (Scope of Application) When an 부착명령 is sentenced against a person under 19 years of age, an electronic device under this Act may not be attached until the person reaches 19 years of age.

Article 5 (Petition for an Attachment Order) ① A prosecutor may file with the court a petition for an order to attach an electronic device (hereinafter referred to as an “attachment order”) against a person who falls under any of the following subparagraphs and is deemed likely to commit a 성폭력범죄 again.
1. Where a person who has been sentenced to an actual term of imprisonment with 노동 for a 성폭력범죄 commits a 성폭력범죄 within 10 years after the execution thereof has been completed or exempted
2. Where a person who has previously been attached with an electronic device under this Act for a 성폭력범죄 again commits a 성폭력범죄
3. Where a person has committed a 성폭력범죄 two or more times (including cases where a final and conclusive judgment of conviction has been rendered) and thus a habitual pattern is recognized
4. Where a 성폭력범죄 is committed against a person under 16 years of age
④ A petition for an attachment order under paragraphs 1 through 3 shall be filed by the time the appellate proceedings of a 특정범죄사건 in which an indictment has been instituted are concluded.
⑤ When the court deems it necessary to sentence an attachment order as a result of hearing a 특정범죄사건 in which an indictment has been instituted, it may require the prosecutor to file a petition for an attachment order.
⑥ No petition for an attachment order may be filed if 15 years have elapsed from the institution of an indictment without a final judgment in a 특정범죄사건 under paragraphs 1 through 3.

Article 6 (Investigation) ① When deemed necessary in order to file a petition for an attachment order, a prosecutor may request the head of the 보호관찰소 (including its branch office; hereinafter the same shall apply) having jurisdiction over the residence of the suspect or the location of the prosecutor’s office to which the suspect belongs (including its branch office; hereinafter the same shall apply) to investigate matters necessary regarding the suspect, such as the motive for the crime, the relationship with the victim, 심리상태, and the risk of 재범.
④ In filing a petition for an attachment order, the prosecutor shall, if necessary, refer to the results of a 정신감정 of the suspect or other expert diagnosis.

Article 9 (Judgment on Attachment Order, etc.) ① When the court deems a petition for an attachment order to be well-founded, it shall sentence an attachment order by judgment, setting the attachment period within the following periods. Provided, however, that where a 특정범죄 is committed against a person under 13 years of age, the lower limit of the attachment period shall be twice the lower limit of the attachment period under the following subparagraphs.
1. Specific crimes for which the upper limit of the statutory punishment is death or life imprisonment: not less than 10 years and not more than 30 years
2. Specific crimes for which the lower limit of the term of imprisonment among the statutory punishments is fixed-term imprisonment of not less than 3 years (excluding specific crimes falling under subparagraph 1): not less than 3 years and not more than 20 years
3. Specific crimes for which the lower limit of the term of imprisonment among the statutory punishments is fixed-term imprisonment of less than 3 years (excluding specific crimes falling under subparagraph 1 or 2): not less than 1 year and not more than 10 years
③ A person sentenced to an attachment order shall be subject to 보호관찰 under the Act on Probation, etc. during the attachment period.
④ The court shall dismiss a petition for an attachment order by judgment when it falls under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. When the petition for an attachment order is deemed to be without merit
2. When a judgment or decision of 무죄 (excluding cases where 의료 treatment and custody is sentenced on the ground of 심신상실), extinguishment of prosecution, or dismissal of prosecution is rendered in a specific crime case
3. When a fine is imposed in a specific crime case
4. When a suspended sentence or suspension of execution is imposed in a specific crime case (excluding cases where attachment of an electronic device is ordered pursuant to Article 28(1))
⑤ A judgment in a case involving a petition for an attachment order shall be rendered simultaneously with the judgment in the specific crime case.
⑦ The pronouncement of an attachment order shall not be considered favorably in sentencing for the specific crime case.

Article 9-2 (Compliance Requirements) ① When sentencing an attachment order pursuant to Article 9(1), the court may, within the scope of the attachment period, set a compliance period and impose one or more of the following compliance requirements. Provided, however, that the compliance requirement under subparagraph 4 shall have its period set within the scope of 500 hours.
1. Restriction on going out during nighttime or at specific times
2. Prohibition of entry into specific areas or places
2-2. Restriction on residential areas
3. Prohibition of approach to specific persons, such as victims
4. Completion of a specific crime treatment program
5. Other matters necessary for the prevention of 재범 and the correction of 성행 of a person sentenced to an attachment order

Article 14-2 (Extension, etc. of Attachment Period) ① If a person subject to attachment falls under any of the following subparagraphs, the court may, upon a petition by a prosecutor filed at the request of the head of the 보호관찰소, extend the attachment period within the limit of 1 year or make a decision to add or modify the compliance requirements under Article 9-2(1).
1. Where a compliance requirement under Article 32 of the Act on Probation, etc. has been violated without justifiable grounds
2. Where the report has not been made in violation of Article 14(2) without justifiable grounds
3. Where, in violation of Article 14(3), the person moved residence, traveled within the country, or departed from the country without permission, or obtained permission by false means, without justifiable grounds
② Even where there is a change in circumstances other than those prescribed in the subparagraphs of paragraph 1, the court may, if it deems there to be reasonable grounds, make a decision to add, modify, or delete the compliance requirements under Article 9-2(1) upon a petition by a prosecutor filed at the request of the head of the 보호관찰소.

Article 16 (Preservation, Use, Destruction, etc. of Received Data) ① The head of the 보호관찰소 shall receive the 전자파 emitted from the electronic device of a person subject to attachment and preserve the data therefrom (hereinafter referred to as “received data”).
② The received data may not be inspected, queried, or disclosed except in the following cases:
1. Where used as investigation or trial materials concerning a suspicion of a specific crime committed by the person subject to attachment
2. Where used by a 보호관찰관 for the purpose of guidance and assistance
3. Where used for the review of the provisional suspension of an attachment order and its revocation by the 보호관찰심사위원회 under Article 5 of the Act on Probation, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Review Committee”)
④ When a prosecutor or judicial police officer inspects or queries the received data, they shall present a warrant of seizure and search issued by a judge.
⑤ The head of the 보호관찰소 shall destroy the received data when it falls under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. Where the sentence imposed together with the attachment order becomes extinguished under Article 81 of the Criminal Act
2. Where the sentence imposed together with the attachment order loses its effect due to pardon
3. Where five years have elapsed since the person whose attachment of the electronic device has ended has completed the attachment of the electronic device without having been subjected to a sentence of suspension of qualifications or to attachment of an electronic device under this Act
⑥ Necessary matters concerning the preservation, use, destruction, etc. of received data shall be prescribed by 대통령령.

Article 17 (Application for Provisional Suspension of Attachment Order, etc.) ① The head of the 보호관찰소, the person subject to attachment, and his or her 법정대리인 may apply to the Review Committee having jurisdiction over the relevant 보호관찰소 for provisional suspension of the attachment order.
② The application under paragraph 1 shall be made after 3 months have elapsed from the date on which execution of the attachment order commenced. If the application is dismissed, a new application may be made after 3 months have elapsed from the date of dismissal.

Article 19 (Revocation of Provisional Suspension, etc.) ① The head of the 보호관찰소 may apply to the Review Committee for revocation of provisional suspension when a person whose attachment order has been provisionally suspended is deemed to pose a risk of 재범, such as by committing a specific crime or failing to comply with reports on residence changes. In such case, when the Review Committee deems that the risk of 재범 of the person whose provisional suspension has been granted is significant, it shall revoke the provisional suspension.
② A person whose provisional suspension is revoked pursuant to paragraph 1 shall attach the electronic device during the remaining attachment period. In such case, the period of provisional suspension shall not be included in the attachment period.

Article 36 (Penalties) ① Where a person in charge of electronic device attachment duties, without justifiable grounds, releases or damages the electronic device of a person subject to attachment, he or she shall be punished by fixed-term imprisonment with 노동 for not less than 1 year.
② Where a person in charge of electronic device attachment duties receives, demands, or promises money, valuables, or other benefits and commits the offense under paragraph 1, he or she shall be punished by fixed-term imprisonment with 노동 for not less than 2 years.
③ Where a person who manages received data violates Article 16(2), he or she shall be punished by fixed-term imprisonment with 노동 for not less than 1 year.

Article 38 (Penalties) Where a person subject to attachment violates Article 14 (including cases where it applies mutatis mutandis pursuant to Articles 27 and 31) and, during the attachment period of the electronic device, arbitrarily detaches or damages the electronic device from the body, interferes with radio waves, tampers with the received data, or otherwise impairs its utility, he or she shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than 7 years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won.

Article 39 (Penalties) ① Where a person subject to attachment violates the compliance requirement under Article 9-2(1) subparagraph 3 or 4 without justifiable grounds, he or she shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than 3 years or by a fine not exceeding 10 million won.
② Where a person subject to attachment violates the compliance requirement under Article 9-2(1) subparagraph 1, subparagraph 2, subparagraph 2-2, or subparagraph 5 without justifiable grounds, he or she shall be punished by a fine not exceeding 10 million won.

Supplementary Provisions to the Act on the Attachment, etc. of Electronic Devices for Location Tracking of Specific Criminal Offenders (Act No. 9112 of 2008. 6. 13., as amended by Act No. 10257 of 2010. 4. 15.)

Act on the Protection of Personal Liberty (2007. 12. 21. 법률 제8724호로 제정된 것)

Immigration Control Act (2014. 3. 18. 법률 제12421호로 개정된 것)
Article 46 (Persons Subject to Deportation) ① 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 이 장에서 정한 procedures에 따라 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 foreigner를 대한민국 밖으로 deport할 수 있다.
(Items omitted)

Article 52 (Period and Place of Detention) ① 제51조에 따라 보호된 foreigner가 강제퇴거 대상자인지 examine and determine하기 위한 보호기간은 10일 이내로 한다. 다만, 부득이한 reason이 있으면 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장의 permission을 받아 10일을 초과하지 아니하는 범위에서 한 차례만 연장할 수 있다.

③ 법무부장관은 제2항에 따른 decision을 하기 전에 필요하면 concerned persons의 statements를 들을 수 있다.
Article 63 (Detention and Release from Detention of a Person Who Has Received a Deportation Order) ① 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 강제퇴거명령을 받은 사람을 여권 미소지 또는 transportation 미확보 등의 이유로 즉시 대한민국 밖으로 repatriate할 수 없으면, 그를 송환할 수 있을 때까지 detention facility에 보호할 수 있다.
② 제1항에 따라 사람을 보호하는 경우 그 period가 3개월을 넘으면 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장은 3개월마다 미리 법무부장관의 approval을 받아야 한다.

⑤ 지방출입국ㆍ외국인관서의 장이 제3항 또는 제4항에 따라 protection을 release하는 경우에는 residence restriction 또는 그 밖의 necessary conditions를 붙일 수 있다.

{"[2015HEONMA1204]": "1. Summary of the Case
가. Suspect 윤○현 was arrested by an arrest warrant at around 19:00 on 2015. 10. 5., and a detention warrant was 청구되었다. The Claimant, an attorney, was entrusted by the above suspect’s family, and after 전화문의 at around 17:00 on 2015. 10. 6. to the Respondent prosecutor of the XX District Prosecutors’ Office who was investigating the case hereinafter the Respondent Prosecutor whether counsel visitation was possible, he visited XX District Prosecutors’ Office XX호 검사실 at around 19:00 on the same day with a visitation application and applied to the Respondent Prosecutor for counsel visitation.
나. The Respondent correctional officer of the XX Detention Center who was in charge of escorting the above suspect hereinafter the Respondent Correctional Officer received custody of the above suspect from the Respondent Prosecutor’s office at around 17:00 on the same day and kept him waiting in the detention room within the prosecutor’s office, and then at around 19:10 on the same day, upon receiving a request from the Respondent Prosecutor to summon the suspect for night questioning, brought the above suspect into the prosecutor’s office.
다. The Respondent Prosecutor informed the Respondent Correctional Officer that the Claimant had made an application for visitation, and the Respondent Correctional Officer after inquiring with the official in charge of counsel visitation at the XX Detention Center about the handling procedure informed the Claimant that pursuant to Article 58(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners counsel visitation could not be permitted because the working hours under the Regulations on the Service of National Public Officials 09:00 to 18:00 had elapsed.
라. Thereafter the Respondent Prosecutor took no further action regarding the Claimant’s visitation application, and the Claimant remained in the prosecutor’s office but ultimately left without visiting the above suspect. After the Claimant left, the Respondent Prosecutor continued questioning the above suspect, and the Claimant was not retained as counsel for the above suspect.
마. The Claimant filed the present constitutional complaint on 2015. 12. 28., alleging that the acts of the Respondents in denying the application for counsel visitation, and Article 58(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners, which the Respondent Correctional Officer relied upon as the legal basis therefor, infringed his fundamental rights.

2. Subject Matter of Adjudication
The issue in this case is whether ① the acts of the Respondents in failing to take measures to permit visitation between the Claimant and suspect 윤○현 at prosecutor’s office room No. XX of the XX District Prosecutors’ Office at around 19:00 on 2015. 10. 6. hereinafter the Prosecutor’s denial of visitation in this case shall be referred to as the Prosecutor’s denial of visitation in this case, the Respondent Correctional Officer’s denial of visitation shall be referred to as the Correctional Officer’s denial of visitation in this case, and these acts collectively as the denial of visitation in this case, and ② Article 58(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners wholly amended by Presidential Decree No. 21095 on 2008. 10. 29. hereinafter the Visitation Hours Provision in this case infringes the Claimant’s fundamental rights hereinafter the Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners shall be referred to as the Execution of Sentences Act.

[Provision Subject to Adjudication]
Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners wholly amended by Presidential Decree No. 21095 on 2008. 10. 29.
Article 58 Visitation (1) Visitation by a prisoner shall take place every day excluding public holidays and days designated by the Minister of Justice within working hours pursuant to Article 9 of the Regulations on the Service of National Public Officials.

Criminal Procedure Act enacted by Act No. 341 on 1954. 9. 23.

Criminal Procedure Act amended by Act No. 8496 on 2007. 6. 1.
Article 243-2 Participation of Defense Counsel, etc. (1) A prosecutor or judicial police officer shall, upon application by a suspect or his or her defense counsel, legal representative, spouse, lineal relative, brother, or sister, allow defense counsel to visit the suspect or allow defense counsel to participate in the interrogation of the suspect unless there is a justifiable ground.
(2) to (5) Omitted

Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners wholly amended by Act No. 8728 on 2007. 12. 21.

Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Sentences and Treatment of Prisoners amended by Presidential Decree No. 25397 on 2014. 6. 25.
Article 58 Visitation (1) Omitted
(2) Except for untried prisoners who visit with defense counsel including persons intending to become defense counsel the same shall apply hereinafter, the visitation time for prisoners shall be limited to not more than 30 minutes per visit.
(3) The number of visits by prisoners shall be four times per month.
(4) Visitation by prisoners shall take place in a place equipped with contact-blocking facilities provided, however, that this shall not apply in any of the following cases.
